$comment: specify-capability-rows 29.1: a lead line can name one of its product's variants by code (variantSku), which the price resolver prices (ProductCatalogService::resolveEffectivePrice) and LeadLinePricer already reads; the line form sends it with the product and quantity and asks again when it changes. LeadLineVariantGuard refuses a code the product does not carry. Sorted after the price-resolve fragment so the lists it replaces (when) are the merged ones: lead 1.9.0 -> 1.10.0, leadProduct 1.4.0 -> 1.5.0.

variantSku.title: Variant code
